name: dewbow-workspace
description: Dewbow Core and Team services, Web clients, and shared libraries

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow-team/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow-team/protocol && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/tests/team-core.test.mjs
scripts.host-daemon: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/sdk && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/host-daemon && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/host-daemon --
scripts.control-plane: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow/control-plane && npm run start --workspace @dewbow/control-plane --
scripts.team: npm run build --workspace @dewbow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow-team/protocol && npm run build --workspace @dewbow-team/backend && npm run start --workspace @dewbow-team/backend --
